title: RelayIQ
sub: Decides whether a lead is worth enriching before you pay for it.

bullets.text: 3.3x lower cost per usable lead on a 495-case seeded benchmark: a multi-step agent routes each field to the best-fit enrichment provider and only spends a credit when it's worth it.

Raised precision from 0.682 to 0.784 across six strategies on synthetic truth: the confidence score reads overconfident above 0.8 (Brier 0.164, ECE 0.091 on 783 synthetic fields), so low-confidence HubSpot writes are gated for human approval - fixture-tested, live sync unverified.
